title: Comet Cup
tagline: Orbit golf on a star chart: sling a comet past singing planets into the cup.
pitch: Pull back, let go, and watch your comet curl around pastel worlds on a nineteenth-century star chart until it drops into the gilded cup. Every planet rings a note as you pass, so each shot plays a little melody. Nine plates a course, a new course every day, and every plate can be aced: after each one you're shown how.
controls: Drag back from anywhere on the plate and let go to launch; tap to fast-forward. Keys: arrows aim, Space launches, P pauses, M mutes.
